column1: # One line per version that has a painted plate in docs/art/, written by
# tools/chronicle-art.sh the one time it asked for that version and read by
# tools/chronicle.sh into the chapter. Append-only: a line in here is what
# stops the same commit ever being painted twice, so it is not rewritten and
# it is not reordered. A version with no line simply has no plate.

column3: Somebody went in under the hood and closed it again.
The game asks who is flying now, and it remembers what they did.
The cabinet keeps score with slightly different arithmetic now.
The picture changed. The game denies that it did. The HUD says so, too.
The rules of the field changed while nobody was flying.
The cabinet keeps score with slightly different arithmetic now. The screen was told as well.
The soundtrack picked up a habit. The panels caught up.
